method: Three original copper cups and links rotate hierarchically beneath the original stationary hook. Overlapping connector regions preserve attachment. One soft painted-style water bead is an added action effect; no swarm or stream.

actions.idle: Small lagged cup sway under a fixed hook.
actions.attack: Bottom cup gathers then tips left, tossing one bead up and left; higher cups absorb the response and return.
actions.hurt: A brief rightward chain recoil travels through three joints, then settles left.
actions.defeat: Three cups slacken into an increasingly left-tipped, dim inactive chain; top hook remains.
actions.cast: A slower upward relay passes one bead through bottom, middle and upper cup, with three timed cup tips.

orientation.method: Each opening is tilted upper-left even at rest; leftward tips and upward-left bead paths direct actions toward the kid. No reflection, text or prop reversal.
